metadata.title: BDDR current free groundwater quantities
metadata.rounding_note: The official register publishes resource and abstraction values as rounded whole l/s and the exploitation index as a whole percent. Derived arithmetic from displayed values can therefore differ slightly from the official published free quantity or exploitation index. Official published values are preserved unchanged.
metadata.note: Current register. Must not be confused with PURB 2022-2027 planning-cycle resource values.
